blocks.text:
This document, like so much other great software out there, was
created for free by volunteers. If you are at all knowledgeable about
any aspect of gtkmm that does not already have documentation, please
consider contributing to this document.
blocks.zh: 本文档和其他出色的软件一样，是由志愿者免费创建的。如果你对任何一个gtkmm没有文档的部分有所了解，请考虑帮助编写/翻译本文档。

blocks.text:
Ideally, we would like you to [
provide a merge request](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gtkmm-documentation/-/merge_requests) to the `docs/tutorial/C/index-in.docbook` file.
This file is in the `gtkmm-documentation` module in GNOME git.
blocks.zh: 理想情况下，我们希望你向 docs/tutorial/C/index-in.docbook 文件提交 merge request。该文件位于 GNOME git 的 gtkmm-documentation 模块中。

blocks.text:
If you do decide to contribute, please post your contribution as an issue or merge request
to [GitLab](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gtkmm-documentation).
You can also discuss your ideas on GNOME's [Discourse](https://discourse.gnome.org)
instance, under the [
Platform/Language bindings](https://discourse.gnome.org/c/platform/language-bindings) category with a `cplusplus` tag.
Also, be aware that the entirety of this document is free, and any addition you provide
must also be free. That is, people must be able to use any portion of
your examples in their programs, and copies of this document
(including your contribution) may be distributed freely.
blocks.zh: 如果你决定贡献，请把你的贡献以 issue 或 merge request 的形式提交到 GNOME GitLab 上的 gtkmm-documentation 仓库。你也可以在 GNOME 的 Discourse 论坛的 Platform/Language bindings 分类下（带 cplusplus 标签）讨论你的想法。另外请注意，本文档整体是自由的，你补充的内容也必须是自由的——也就是说，人们必须能在自己的程序中使用你示例的任何部分，本文档的副本（包括你的贡献）也可以自由分发。
